db.sql: SELECT t.id, t.status, t.progress_done, t.progress_total, a.approval_id, a.status AS approval_status FROM threads t JOIN biz_events e ON e.session_id = t.id JOIN approvals a ON a.event_id = e.event_id WHERE t.workspace_id='ws-yunqi' AND t.status='completed' AND a.status='pending'
SELECT id, status, progress_done, progress_total FROM threads WHERE workspace_id='ws-yunqi' AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(progress_done,0) < COALESCE(progress_total,0)
